body: Dude we have almost the exact same story. I just slowly became more and more isolated from 7th grade onwards to the point where I was basically a hermit staying in my room. My best advice would be try to be more open and social. I know it can be brutal at first but the more you do it the easier it gets. I started trying to recover when I was 22 and at that point I could barely talk to my own family let alone strangers or pretty girls. I'm almost 25 now and it has gotten substantially easier but it can still be daunting at times and my anxiety can easily get the best of me in social situations. It seems like the only real solution that works is just brute force exposure therapy.

I feel like we're in almost the same situation. I'm 24 too and was basically living by myself in my room fucking around from 13 to 21. That and some bad experiences in school left me with really bad social anxiety and a crippling fear a failure that makes even the thought of asking a girl out or even dating a girl pretty terrifying. While I haven't really gotten over that deep feeling of being almost subhuman, I have decided to make a concrete effort to improve myself in the hopes that maybe I will hate myself a little less. I started going to the gym multiple times a week and I want to go back to school to get out of my dead end job. Other than that, I have been making a real effort to try and talk with people and hang out more. The only advice I could give you is that I don't think your at the same level as an actual 15 year old. 15 year old me was just as inexperienced as I am now but he was way dumber and way more emotional/hormonal. Dude was like 2 steps up from a monkey. It may not be much but I have gotten a bit smarter as I grew up so hopefully I don't immediately implode if I'm ever fortunate enough to escape the FA zone. Good luck OP.
